mentions.name: Native music transcription practice app
mentions.description: A native desktop application for Windows, Linux, and macOS that assists with music transcription. It provides time stretch and pitch shift, lets users save loop regions and take notes, and is designed to serve as a practice session tool. It is built from first principles, using GPU code and platform shims, with heavy optimization for speed and smoothness.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A native application (Windows, Linux, MacOS) for music transcription.

It comes with time stretch and pitch shift as most of these softwares do, but it allows you to save loop regions and take notes. It's designed to be a practice session tool.
